fact: Somalia's National Communications Authority signed an MoU with iRise Hub, an innovation hub, on innovation, entrepreneurship and startup support; no programme or cohort is stated.
Under the EU-funded, UNIDO-implemented BIC Somali Project, over 200 startups have received incubation support across three cohorts, the latest assisting 75 businesses.

Red Sea University-Somalia says it hosted the official opening ceremony of RSU iHub in Bosaso, which aims to serve as a platform for technology and business incubation for students and graduates, with no programme or cohort stated.

The BIC Somali Project, implemented by UNIDO with EU funding, graduated entrepreneurs who completed business incubation, and iRise Hub, SIMAD iLab and HarHub signed an MoU to harmonise incubation standards.
The three hubs named are in Mogadishu and Hargeisa, with graduation ceremonies held in both cities.
